payload.prompt: Drag these inference priorities into your order of preference.

items.label: Speed
items.detail: Sub-second token-by-token responses for chat-style use.

items.label: Quality
items.detail: Deeper reasoning and richer answers, even if slower.

items.label: Cost
items.detail: Stay local-first; avoid cloud API spend.

items.label: Privacy
items.detail: Keep prompts + outputs strictly on this machine.

payload.prompt: Order these chat modes by which one you want as your default.

items.label: Quick
items.detail: Fastest response — minion-only on simple prompts.

items.label: Pondering Deeply
items.detail: Brain extends its thinking budget for one richer answer.

items.label: Council
items.detail: Multiple minions vote; brain summarizes consensus.

items.label: Reasoning with Others
items.detail: Brain + cloud API exchange and reconcile drafts.

payload.prompt: Rank these AI capabilities by usefulness to you.

items.label: Code generation
items.detail: Write functions, classes, and tests from a description.

items.label: Code review
items.detail: Read existing code and flag issues / suggest fixes.

items.label: Documentation drafts
items.detail: Generate README / doc-comment / changelog text.

items.label: Semantic codebase search
items.detail: Find the right file / function by describing what it does.

items.label: Voice-to-text + back
items.detail: Talk to the assistant; hear it talk back.

payload.prompt: Order these qualities by importance when picking a chat brain.

items.label: Time-to-first-token
items.detail: How long until the first word appears on screen.

items.label: Tokens per second
items.detail: Sustained generation speed once the reply is flowing.

items.label: Context window length
items.detail: How many tokens of conversation history the brain can hold.

items.label: VRAM footprint
items.detail: How much GPU memory the model needs to run.

items.label: License terms
items.detail: Whether the model is OK for commercial use, redistribution, etc.

payload.prompt: Drag these features into the order you want me to enable first.

items.label: Chat brain
items.detail: Talk to a local LLM, get answers.

items.label: Voice in / out
items.detail: Hands-free assistant via STT + TTS.

items.label: Semantic memory
items.detail: Save things now; recall them by meaning later.

items.label: Vision (read images + screen)
items.detail: Drop an image or share screen; the brain reads it.

items.label: Multi-model council
items.detail: Several minions debate; brain summarizes.

payload.prompt: Rank these intelligence-layer surfaces by how often you'd use them.

items.label: System Memory
items.detail: Long-lived facts about your projects and preferences.

items.label: Working Memory
items.detail: Per-session scratchpad the brain reads from / writes to mid-turn.

items.label: Thinking surface
items.detail: Live view of the brain's reasoning trace.

items.label: Councils
items.detail: Multi-minion debate transcripts with consensus path highlighted.

payload.prompt: Order these editor integrations by priority for your workflow.

items.label: Inline completion
items.detail: Ghost-text suggestions while you type.

items.label: Chat-driven edits
items.detail: Describe a change; the assistant rewrites the selection.

items.label: Explain code on hover
items.detail: Hover any symbol; get a one-paragraph plain-English summary.

items.label: Test generation
items.detail: Click a function; get a test stub seeded with realistic cases.

payload.prompt: What should the platform protect most aggressively?

items.label: Battery life
items.detail: Throttle background work to keep the laptop cool + quiet.

items.label: RAM availability
items.detail: Cap concurrent model loads so other apps stay responsive.

items.label: Disk space
items.detail: Aggressive eviction of stale models and intermediate cache.

items.label: Network usage
items.detail: Never pull a model larger than the user explicitly opted into.
